{{Infobox auto}}

A '''buñuelo''' is a fried dough fritter that heals {{Hp|6}} and grants {{EffectLink|Luck}} for 3 minutes.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/food/crafting/bunuelo.json}}</ref>

== Obtaining ==

=== Crafting ===
{{Recipes}}
Dough, [[oil]], estus ash and sugar. Obtaining oil unlocks the recipe. The oil's glass bottle is meant to be given back, but in 1.12.2-beta the advancement that returns it still names the recipe by an old ID, so it is used up.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/advancement/mechanics/glass_bottle_from_crafting.json}}</ref>

== Usage ==

=== Food ===
Eating a buñuelo takes 1.2 seconds, heals {{Hp|6}} and gives Luck for 3:00. The pack gives its chest loot tables quality values, so Luck improves the loot of chests opened while it lasts.<ref>{{Cite changelog|1.12.1-alpha|quote=Luck works, I've added the quality field to all chest loottables and even some other things.}}</ref>

=== Trading ===
{{Upcoming|type=section}}
It is one of the foods a villager will be able to ask for as its [[favorite food]].
